data.long_meaning: The meaning of Gibeon is recorded in name-lists as “Hill of God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gibeon expresses “Hill of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gibeon total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

in_hebrew.name: גִבְעוֹן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word גבע (gibbā), which means hill, mound, or hillock. The name Gibeon may refer to a place or person associated with a hill or high place.

in_greek.name: Γεβεων
in_greek.long_meaning: Transliteration of the Hebrew name into Greek. The Greek form of the name is Γεβεων (Gebēon).

in_latin.name: Gibeeon
in_latin.long_meaning: Latin transliteration of the Greek form of the name. The Latin form of the name is Gibeeon.
